Name: Farm Stall Lite
Author: Stoel1994
Description:
[center][b]Farm Stall Lite[/b][i]A Lightweight, Immersive Farm-to-Table Sales Mod[/i]Tired of throwing your hard-earned artisan goods into a shipping bin where they disappear into the void? [b]Farm Stall Lite[/b] adds a functional, immersive farm stall to your property that allows you to sell goods directly to the residents of Pelican Town.
[b]Features[/b][list]
[*][b]Direct Sales:[/b] Place your produce, artisan goods, and foraged items in the stall. Overnight, villagers will stop by to browse.
[*][b]Dynamic Ledger:[/b] Wake up to a personalized ledger showing exactly who stopped by, what they bought, and how much gold you earned.
[*][b]Barter System:[/b] Not everyone pays in gold! Some neighbors might leave behind useful resources like wood, stone, ores, or animal products in exchange for your goods.
[*][b]Vanilla Integration:[/b] Uses a custom building type that fits perfectly with the Stardew Valley aesthetic.
[*][b]Smart Filtering:[/b] The stall knows what it can hold. It accepts shelf-stable goods and cold items (fruits, veggies, dairy, artisan products) while keeping your tools and furniture safe in your backpack.
[/list][b]How it Works[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Load the Stall:[/b] Use the left side of the stall to place items you want to sell.

[*][b]Wait Overnight:[/b] While you sleep, a random selection of villagers will visit.

[*][b]Collect Earnings:[/b] Check the right side of the stall (the Output box) to collect any bartered goods. Your gold earnings are added directly to your pocket.

[*][b]Read the News:[/b] A daily ledger will pop up at the start of the day to keep you informed of your stall's performance.

[/list][b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list][b]
